run_vlm_training: run VLM training by passing a training config JSON file path via --training_config argument
run_vqa_training: run VQA training by setting trainer to vqa in the training config JSON file
run_captioning_training: run captioning training by setting trainer to captioning in the training config JSON file
review_train_function: review the train function that validates model support and dispatches to vqa or captioning trainers
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines the --training_config CLI argument
